capability_scale.meaning: 1 is weak fit; 5 is strong fit for the named visual task.

resolver_contract.exploratory_candidate_filter: all media; pending entries require manual review
resolver_contract.generation_reference_policy: Send only selected reference_panels, never the complete 3x3 card.

panel_policy.model_reference: Use only task-relevant cropped panels; do not use the full 3x3 card.

limitations: Visual reference only; not a craft, chemical-safety, or medical evidence source.
Generated card text may contain spelling, translation, or factual errors.
Fixed pomegranate, portrait, anatomy, and village motifs are test subjects, not reusable content requirements.
Digital methods M72-M75 are classified separately from traditional physical media.
